constraints: Does nothing if there is no current record.
The record is displayed only until an event redraws the window (e.g. ADD RECORD, returning to an input form, or returning to the menu bar).
Must not be called from within a Web connection process: it would execute on the 4D Web server machine, not the Web browser client machine.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Displays the current record of aTable in its current input form, e.g. for custom progress messages or a free-running slide show.
